chunks: Those to whom We have given the Scriptures rejoice in what We have sent down to you; but some of their factions reject some of it. Tell them: 'I am commanded to worship only God, and not to associate compeers with Him. To Him I call you, and to Him is the destination.'
ai.seo_question: How did the People of the Book react to the revelation of the Quran according to Surah Ar-Ra'd?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the dual nature of the People of the Book, where the faithful among them recognize the Quran as the fulfillment of their scriptures, while the partisan factions (Al-Ahzaab) reject portions due to tribal or political bias. It concludes with the Prophet’s declaration of pure monotheism (Tawhid), emphasizing that his mission is solely to worship Allah and return to Him, a theme central to the concept of divine authority (Imamah) as the guide to that ultimate return.
